issues.detail: The Greek 'παραστησει' (parastēsei) is a future active verb meaning 'will stand' or 'will station.' The Vietnamese translation 'đặt trước mặt ta' (place before me) changes the action from the angels standing/positioning themselves to an unspecified agent placing them there.

The Greek text implies a question or a statement of fact regarding the angels 'standing' for him, but the Vietnamese phrasing 'Ngài sẽ đặt...' (He will place...) introduces a subject ('Ngài' - He) that is not explicitly present in the Greek verb structure.
